TahmKenchQ.name: Tongue Lash
TahmKenchQ.tooltip:
Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

On champion hit, heals Tahm for @BaseHeal@ +@PercentHealthHealing*100@% of his missing Health and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste dealing @Spell.TahmKenchPassive:TotalDamage@ extra magic damage. If that champion already had 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they will also be Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds, consuming the stacks.

Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from a distance when you hit them.
Tongue Lash's range increases with Tahm Kench's size

TahmKenchW.name: Abyssal Dive
TahmKenchW.tooltip:
Dive down and then re-appear at target location, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Knock Up all enemies in an area for @KnockupDuration@ second. Hitting at least one enemy champion refunds @ChampRefund*100@% of the Cooldown and Mana cost.

Devoured allies can be taken along for the ride (but can always hop out early).
Enemies cannot see where you are headed to until @EnemyWarningDelayFromChannelStart@ seconds into the channel.

'Boy, the world's one river, and I'm its king. Ain't no place I ain't been; ain't no place I can't go again.'

TahmKenchPassive.name: An Acquired Taste
TahmKenchPassive.tooltip:
Attacks deal @TotalDamage@ bonus magic damage. Against champions, they add a stack of An Acquired Taste for @Duration@ seconds, up to @MaxStacks@ times.

At @MaxStacks@ stacks, Tongue Lash and Devour become empowered against that champion.

TahmKenchRWrapper.name: Devour
TahmKenchRWrapper.tooltip:
Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out.

Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste. Are devoured for up to @EnemyDuration@ seconds and take @BaseDamage@ (+@PercentHPDamage@ of their Max Health) magic damage. Tahm Kench is Slowed by @SlowAmount*100@% and Grounded during this effect.

Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to @AllyDuration@ seconds and are granted @TotalShield@ Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast Abyssal Dive and gains @AllySpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @AllyDuration@ seconds.
Allies can see when this spell is available next to your health bar (enemies cannot).
Shield decays by @ShieldDecayPerSecond@ per second.

TahmKenchE.name: Thick Skin
TahmKenchE.tooltip:
Passive: @GreyHealthRatio*100@% of damage Tahm Kench takes is stored by his Thick Skin, increased to @GreyHealthRatioEnhanced*100@% if there are at least @EnhancedThreshold@ nearby enemy champions. If Kench has not taken damage within @OOCTimer@ seconds, Thick Skin will rapidly be consumed to heal Tahm for @GreyHealthHealingRatio@ of its value.

Active: Convert all your stored Thick Skin into a Shield, lasting @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
Grey Health is capped at @GreyHealthMaximum@
